species_support: recombinant WNT5B and human FZD1; bovine Go in reconstituted assay; murine 32D system for separate mapping
evidence_summary: Purified WNT5B bound the FZD1 cysteine-rich domain by bio-layer interferometry, weakly (KD >40 nM). A separate bacterial-membrane reconstitution used human FZD1 and showed WNT5B-dependent Go guanine-nucleotide exchange, establishing receptor-dependent activation.
limitations: The CRD assay is not a full-length holoreceptor and the affinity is weak. The reconstitution uses detergent-solubilized receptor, bovine Go, and WNT preparation carrier effects; it does not resolve LRP5/6, ROR, or RYK co-receptor composition.
audit_notes: Exact WNT5B, not WNT5A, is present in the binding and FZD1 activation assays. The 2015 32D functional arm did not test WNT5B, so it was not used as exact-pair function evidence.

species_support: recombinant WNT5B and FZD2 CRD; human MRC-5 and primary lung fibroblasts; murine 32D system for separate mapping
evidence_summary: Purified WNT5B bound the FZD2 CRD by bio-layer interferometry, weakly (KD >40 nM). In human lung fibroblasts, recombinant WNT5B induced IL-6/CXCL8 release and FZD2 knockdown prevented the response, supporting FZD2-dependent noncanonical function.
limitations: The biochemical binding is weak and CRD-only. The fibroblast study is disease/cell-context specific and receptor dependence is inferred from knockdown rather than a purified WNT5B–full-length FZD2 binding assay; co-receptor composition is unresolved.
audit_notes: The lung-fibroblast paper tests WNT5B separately from WNT5A and reports FZD2 knockdown prevention of the WNT5B response; family-level WNT5A/B co-mention was not used as the sole basis.

species_support: human A549, SPC, and H157 NSCLC cells; mouse xenograft model for downstream phenotype
evidence_summary: The NSCLC study reports endogenous WNT5B–FZD3 co-immunoprecipitation. FZD3 knockdown reduced WNT5B-induced DVL3 phosphorylation and ATF2/PCP-JNK signaling, while other FZD knockdowns did not show the same effect, supporting receptor-dependent function.
limitations: The interaction is cellular co-IP rather than purified affinity or structure, and the disease-model/cell-context specificity limits generalization. No LRP5/6, ROR, RYK, or receptor-complex stoichiometry was resolved.
audit_notes: This is exact WNT5B and FZD3 evidence; the receptor-dependent readout is DVL3 membrane recruitment/phosphorylation and RAC1-PCP-JNK activation, not expression-only association.

species_support: recombinant WNT5B and FZD5 CRD; mouse retinal tissue/cultures; murine 32D system for separate mapping
evidence_summary: Purified WNT5B showed intermediate-to-strong binding to the FZD5 CRD by bio-layer interferometry (KD about 5–22 nM). In mouse retina, Wnt5a/5b loss and combined Fzd4/Fzd5 loss produce the same ectopic outer-plexiform-layer phenotype, and Wnt5b single loss is phenotypic, supporting a noncanonical FZD4/FZD5 receptor context.
limitations: The direct biochemical evidence is CRD-only. The retinal functional genetics combines Wnt5a with Wnt5b and Fzd4 with Fzd5, so it does not assign the full phenotype uniquely to WNT5B–FZD5 or resolve receptor stoichiometry.
audit_notes: Approval rests on exact WNT5B–FZD5 binding; the retinal result is retained as receptor-context function, not treated as an isoform-exclusive WNT5B–FZD5 functional assay.

species_support: human embryonic stem-cell cardiomyocyte cultures; human FZD6 reconstitution tested with other WNT ligands; no exact WNT5B-FZD6 assay established
evidence_summary: The cited cardiomyocyte study co-expresses WNT5A/WNT5B with FZD6 and says this pattern suggests a noncanonical FZD4/FZD6 role; it does not test direct WNT5B–FZD6 binding or FZD6-dependent WNT5B function. The 2015 mapping study excluded FZD6, and the checked FZD6 Go-reconstitution paper specifically describes FZD6 activation by WNT7A and WNT5A, not WNT5B.
limitations: WNT5A/WNT5B family overlap, co-expression, pathway inference, and computational docking cannot establish the exact isoform pair. No qualifying direct binding, structure, or receptor-dependent WNT5B–FZD6 assay was found in the cited/checked primary sources.
audit_notes: Do not transfer FZD6 evidence for WNT5A or general cardiomyocyte WNT5A/5B expression to WNT5B. The candidate remains unvalidated rather than being rejected as biologically impossible.

species_support: recombinant WNT5B and FZD7 CRD; human breast-cancer cell lines; murine 32D system for separate mapping
evidence_summary: Purified WNT5B bound the FZD7 CRD by bio-layer interferometry, weakly (KD >40 nM). A human breast-cancer study further links FZD7 to WNT5A/B-associated noncanonical stemness and reports Wnt5b-dependent downstream effects, although its antibody/co-IP experiments combine WNT5A and WNT5B.
limitations: The biochemical binding is weak and CRD-only. The cancer functional study does not separate WNT5B from WNT5A in the interaction assay and is cell-context specific; the exact full-length receptor complex and co-receptors remain unresolved.
audit_notes: Approval is based on exact WNT5B–FZD7 CRD binding. The WNT5A/B breast-cancer functional evidence is supportive context only and was not treated as isoform-exclusive proof.
